parsed.scene_summary: I eat a breakfast meal on an outdoor terrace, taking a bite of toast, placing a piece in my noodle bowl, drinking from a bowl of soup, commenting that it tastes salty, and then lifting noodles with my fork.

segments.action: I pick up a piece of toast from the white plate with my left hand and take a bite while holding a fork in the noodle bowl with my right hand.
segments.environment: Physical space: An open-air dining terrace of a canteen paved with reddish-brown bricks in a herringbone pattern with raised yellow tactile paving tiles. A clear glass railing overlooks lush green hillside trees and distant residential high-rise towers under an overcast sky. Wooden picnic tables with attached benches are arranged outside the canteen glass windows; another person sits at a distant table. Objects: In front of me sits a wooden table holding a black meal tray with a black bowl of tossed instant noodles topped with a fried pork chop, chopped scallions, and a soft egg, with a metal fork resting inside; a white plate with toasted sandwich halves; a white egg cup containing a whole boiled egg with cracked eggshell bits beside it; a small white bowl of clear yellowish broth; and a white ceramic mug with soup/drink and a spoon inside. A black smartphone rests face-up to the upper-left of the tray with its screen off. Text in world: A green rectangular sticker on the table reads '用餐後請將托盤及餐具 放回托盤回收站 / Please return the tray and utensils to the collection station after dining. Thank you / GOURMET'. Media playing: None. Ambient audio: Distant cafeteria murmur and gentle outdoor ambience.
text_visible: 用餐後請將托盤及餐具
Please return the tray and utensils to the
collection station after dining. Thank you
segments.details: My right hand holds the fork steady against the pork chop in the noodle bowl while my left hand reaches across the tray, lifts a piece of toast, and raises it toward my mouth to take a bite.

segments.action: I tear off a piece of bread and place it into the noodle bowl, then use my fork to press into the pork chop.
segments.environment: A torn white bread crust fragment is placed into the noodle bowl resting over the noodles. My left hand pulls back with bread crumbs on my fingers.
text_visible: 用餐後請將托盤及餐具
segments.details: Using my left hand, I tear a small piece of bread from the toast and drop it into the lower rim of the black noodle bowl, while my right hand adjusts the fork against the pork chop.

segments.action: I look down briefly, then reach my left hand forward to pick up the small white bowl of soup.
segments.environment: My left hand reaches forward across the tray and grasps the rim of the small white soup bowl.
text_visible: 用餐後請將托盤及餐具
segments.details: I look toward the ground momentarily before shifting focus back to the tray, reaching my left hand across the plate to grasp the lip of the small white porcelain soup bowl.

segments.action: I lift the white bowl to my mouth, take a drink of the clear broth, and lower the bowl back down toward the tray.
segments.environment: The soup bowl is lifted up to mouth level, tilted to drink the broth, and then set back down onto the black tray with a slightly reduced liquid volume.
segments.details: I tilt the small white bowl toward my lips with my left hand to drink the warm yellowish broth, then lower it back toward the center of the meal tray.

segments.action: I say '嗯，咸咸的。' after tasting the broth.
segments.environment: The soup bowl is set back on the tray. My left hand rests on the table beside the plate.
text_visible: 用餐後請將托盤及餐具
segments.details: I place the bowl down on the tray, resting my left hand on the wooden tabletop, and comment out loud on the salty flavor of the broth.

segments.action: I use the fork in my right hand to mix the instant noodles and break open the soft-boiled egg in the bowl.
segments.environment: In the distance, a person in a dark top walks along the outdoor terrace. In the noodle bowl, the soft egg is pierced and egg yolk begins blending into the noodles.
text_visible: 用餐後請將托盤及餐具
segments.details: Holding the metal fork in my right hand, I press the prongs into the noodles and the poached egg yolk at the base of the bowl, blending the ingredients together.

segments.action: I twirl my fork in the noodles and lift a large portion of noodles coated in egg and sauce upward.
segments.environment: A tall tangle of noodles coated in sauce and runny egg yolk is elevated several inches above the black bowl on the fork.
text_visible: 用餐後請將托盤及餐具
segments.details: I scoop and swirl the fork through the sauced noodles and lift a generous bundle of noodles straight up from the bowl to prepare to eat them.

text_visible: 1. 通俗理解：什么是“支持向量”？

我先查看官方文档和社区讨论，重点看两件事：一是对话历史能不能回退到某一轮，二是代码工作区能不能一起恢复到对应状态。
我查到了一个关键点：官方现在支持“打开历史对话并基于某一行继续”，但这只恢复对话历史，工作区代码不会恢复。如果要在本地回退……
我查了官方文档和 OpenAI 的 Codex GitHub 社区讨论，结论是：
截至 2026-04-20，Codex 还没有一个官方“一键回退到某次历史对话，并且把代码状态也完整恢复到当时”的统一功能。

      "text": "1. Adaline\n这里最明显的一个，课件直接写了：很多机器学习算法需要 feature scaling 才能有更好的表现，尤其是 gradient descent 在数据接近标准分布时收敛更快。而 Adaline 正是靠平方误差目标函数 + 梯度下降来学习的。\n2. Perceptron\nPerceptron 也会受影响。它的更新量和输入特征 x_j 成正比：某一维如果数值特别大，那一维对应的权重更新就会特别大，于是模型更容易被“大尺度特征”带着走，训练路径不平衡。这个问题通常没有 Adaline 的梯度下降那么典型，但仍然存在。课件也把 feature scaling 放在这一部分的核心预处理里讲了。\n3. Logistic Regression / SVM\n这两个在线性分类器里也通常会受到影响。尤其是你们课件里已经用 scikit-learn 部分先用 StandardScaler 再次训练模型，并且课件明确提到：regularization 需要 feature scaling，才能让各个特征处于可比拟的尺度，否则，大尺度特征会对权重、间隔、正则化惩罚产生不成比例的影响。\n4. KNN\nKNN 也很容易出问题，而且往往很严重。因为 KNN 本质上靠“距离”找邻居：如果一个特征范围是 0-10000，另一个是 0-1，那么距离几乎完全由前者决定，后者基本失去作用。这一点虽然在你给出的片段里没直接写出来，但它是由 KNN 的距离机制直接推导出的。",

    },

      "hkt": "11:55:50",
      "label": "ChatGPT Response - Adaline & Perceptron",

screen_text.label: ChatGPT ML Explanation Window
screen_text.text:
1. Adaline
这里最明显的一个，课件直接写了：很多机器学习算法需要 feature scaling 才能有更好的表现，尤其是 gradient descent 在数据接近标准分布时收敛更快。而 Adaline 正是靠平方误差目标函数 + 梯度下降来学习的。
2. Perceptron
Perceptron 也会受影响。它的更新量和输入特征 x_j 成正比：某一维如果数值特别大，那一维对应的权重更新就会特别大，于是模型更容易被“大尺度特征”带着走，训练路径不平衡。这个问题通常没有 Adaline 的梯度下降那么典型，但仍然存在。课件也把 feature scaling 放在这一部分的核心预处理里讲了。
3. Logistic Regression / SVM
这两个在线性分类器里也通常会受到影响。尤其是你们课件里已经用 scikit-learn 部分先用 StandardScaler 再次训练模型，并且课件明确提到：regularization 需要 feature scaling，才能让各个特征处于可比拟的尺度，否则，大尺度特征会对权重、间隔、正则化惩罚产生不成比例的影响。
4. KNN
KNN 也很容易出问题，而且往往很严重。因为 KNN 本质上靠“距离”找邻居：如果一个特征范围是 0-10000，另一个是 0-1，那么距离几乎完全由前者决定，后者基本失去作用。这一点虽然在你给出的片段里没直接写出来，但它是由 KNN 的距离机制直接推导出的。

核心概念：out-of-bag evaluation（袋外评估）
在执行 bagging / random forest 时，每棵决策树训练时只使用了约 63.2% 的样本，剩余约 36.8% 的样本未参与该树的训练，称为 out-of-bag (OOB) samples。
【核心优势/作用】
1. 不需要额外的验证集/交叉验证

2. 可以作为早停准则

3. 减小过拟合风险
由于评估样本独立于单棵树的训练集，OOB score 是一个无偏估计（unbiased estimate）。

The main benefit of out-of-bag evaluation is that it provides an unbiased estimate of the model's generalization performance without needing a separate validation set.

Your preparation pipeline should transform an email into a (sparse) vector that indicates the presence or absence of each possible word. For example, if all emails only ever contain four words, "Hello", "how", "are", "you", then the email "Hello you Hello Hello you" would be converted into a vector [1, 0, 0, 1] (meaning ["Hello" is present, "how" is absent, "are" is absent, "you" is present]), or [3, 0, 0, 2] if you prefer to count the number of occurrences of each word.
